# Henri Funk (he / him)
### PhD Candidate in Statistics · LMU Munich
:::

::: {.hero}
::: {.hero-photo}
![](images/profile.jpg){.profile-img}
:::

::: {.hero-text}
I'm a PhD candidate at the **[Department of Statistics, LMU Munich](https://www.stat.lmu.de/en/)**, supervised by [Prof. Dr. Helmut Küchenhoff](https://www.lmu.de/mzn/de/mitglieder/kontaktseite/helmut-kuechenhoff-bc664f45.html), working in cooperation with [Prof. Dr. Ralf Ludwig's](https://www.geo.lmu.de/de/fakultaet-geowissenschaften/personen/kontaktseite/ralf-ludwig-13b9822d.html) [working group](https://www.geo.lmu.de/geographie/de/forschung/physische-geographie-und-nexusforschung/ueber-uns/ag-ludwig/) for Applied Physical Geography and Environmental Modeling, a member of the **[Statistical Consulting Unit (StaBLab)](https://www.stat.lmu.de/stablab/en/)**, and affiliated with the **[Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)](https://mcml.ai/research/groups/kuechenhoff/)**.

My research decomposes climate model uncertainty into signal, bias and internal variability, with a focus on droughts: multivariate bias correction with vine copulas, uncertainty quantification, and algorithm-agnostic interpretability for clustering.

## Research interests

My work centers on droughts and climate extremes: decomposing climate model uncertainty into bias, internal variability and forced signal, and carrying that decomposition through to drought characterisation and forecasting.

- Uncertainty decomposition and quantification (aleatoric/epistemic)
- Multivariate bias correction & copula modelling
- Generalised additive models
- Deep learning for probabilistic forecasting
- Explainable / algorithm-agnostic machine learning
